title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1978-04-08
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Kathy Sublette's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM57 mics > Sony-TC158

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience tape of a peak‑era ’78 show, featuring diverse set‑list highlights like Samson & Delilah and Mississippi Half Step.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance – they note the show’s diversity from rocking numbers to trippy jams and heartfelt ballads, with particular love for Samson & Delilah and the Mississippi Half Step opener.  The audience recording is praised for its clarity, audible applause and a well‑balanced mix that even lets Donna’s vocals shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Two solid 4‑star reviews highlight a strong musical performance and an excellent‑quality audience recording, giving the release a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear audience tape with audible applause and cheering; mix is well balanced – especially Donna’s vocals – making it stand out for an audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows through rock, trippy jams, ballads and western‑flavored tunes, delivering a varied and engaging experience that keeps listeners hooked from start to finish.
